scoring_justification: Agent reports computed results; checker compares each value to published gold with tolerances, as DFT rerun is infeasible in verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for half_metal_results.csv from paper Tables I, II, III, IV.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper J. Appl. Phys. 114, 213704 (2013), Tables I and III (lattice constants and gaps) and Tables II and IV (magnetic moments).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published tables for the four half-metallic compounds.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exact paper-reported results for the specific compounds; they are the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Computed equilibrium lattice constant, minority-spin gap, half-metallic gap, total magnetic moment per formula unit, and half-metallic flag for the four V-doped SnTe supercells.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each reported value against a reference (paper's values) with prescribed tolerances. The agent must compute these quantities solely from the DFT procedures; no knowledge of the reference is revealed.
